best_idea: Gate a spell by a skill window (zero chance below its minimum, certain above minimum plus 40, linear between), and let a scroll use the spell at a window two table steps lower, so a found item is a skill-free route to a spell the player has not trained.
decision_why: Take the window ramp and the scroll offset as the access rule for specials; drop the item reagents (17 reagent items with vendor stock) for Frankendom v1, since a mana cost per cast is enough for a fast fight. Reagents as items are a crafting-economy choice the rulings do not ask for.
acceptance: A Third-circle special cast from a book at skill 50 succeeds on a server roll at 75 percent (window 20 to 60); the same special from a scroll always succeeds at skill 50 (window 0 to 40); a unit test asserts castSkillWindow and castChance for both routes and checks that a mana shortfall is refused before any reagent or charge is spent.
